title: Beetroot: modeled ₹666/qtl left, Kondotty → Aroor
summary: January 2023: reported beetroot prices at Kondotty and Aroor imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 87% of 23 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹666 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 242 same-variety market pairs screened for beetroot in January 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Aroor report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2023
scenes.caption: Kondotty (Kerala) and Aroor (Kerala) both reported beetroot prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 23 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kondotty reported a median ₹2,500 per quintal. Aroor reported a median ₹3,700 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,100/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,100 per quintal, and Aroor was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 177 km by road
scenes.caption: 177 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹38/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹730 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹535 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Aroor report, the rule selects 20 of 23 modeled shipping days. 17 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹666 per quintal (₹480 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Beetroot route from Kondotty to Aroor was positive on 87% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹66,600, or ₹48,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to beetroot
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹38/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Beetroot route from Kondotty to Aroor was positive on 87% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹66,600, or ₹48,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
